audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer repeatedly names a fabricated Hwei ability, 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)', which does not exist in his kit (winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t, report[9].t).
audit.why: Hwei's real CC comes from his E stance (Subject: Torment), which swaps his kit into Grim Visage (fear), Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw. There is no ability named 'Subject: Fear' or 'CC Paints' anywhere in his kit per the enemyKit data. The content layer (whys/spikes/early/mid/late) already correctly names Grim Visage, Severing Bolt, Devastating Fire, Stirring Lights, and Fleeting Current — the full layer is the only place carrying the fabrication.
audit.corrected: Replaced every instance with 'his E (Subject: Torment)', the real stance name, and added its per-rank cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) where the field needed a concrete number.

audit.why: Power spikes (level 2 E-Q, level 6 Solar Flare vs his zone, first item survivability, late teamfight R) are already covered accurately in phases[] and spikes[] and did not need correction.

Lane difficulty framing (early poke disadvantage from Devastating Fire/Severing Bolt, mid chain windows, late pick potential) is grounded and consistent with the packet's 50.55% Hwei-favoured win rate and level chart.

edits.before: Pay the rent once and foreclose with the chain. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.
edits.after: Pay the rent once and foreclose with the chain. Track his E (Subject: Torment) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and billing your duo per wave until the all-in is unaffordable.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing his E (Subject: Torment) fear, denying your pattern, and billing your duo per wave until the all-in is unaffordable.

edits.before: - Leona vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Engage when their answer is down — the chain only needs one clean start. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.
edits.after: - Leona vs Hwei - Track: Hwei's E (Subject: Torment). - Engage when their answer is down — the chain only needs one clean start. - Engage only on his E's cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Hwei's E (Subject: Torment): matchup-defining — it cools down 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and his CC lives there — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

notes: The full layer's fabricated ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' matches the packet's own listed defect ('never names any of Hwei's abilities') — it was a placeholder that never got filled with a real name. Replaced everywhere with his real CC stance, E (Subject: Torment), and added its per-rank cooldown in breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d to satisfy the COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT lint finding. Also fixed the two COPY_PASTE_BLEED lint findings: dosFull[1].d ('Eat poke at maximum range') no longer duplicates tradeGood, and dontsFull[2].d ('Trade chip with a sword') no longer duplicates tradeBad — both now say something specific to their own titles. Content layer (win/whys/spikes/early/mid/late/wants) was already accurate with real ability names (Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, Stirring Lights, Grim Visage, Fleeting Current, Solar Flare) and needed no edits. missingInteractions was empty for this matchup and no mirror audit exists yet for hwei_sup vs leona side.
